events.title: Lunchtime Lectures: Building Meaningful Connections in Education
events.description: A short, intellectually engaging lecture focusing on the pedagogy of human connection in educational settings. It is designed for those interested in social psychology and teaching methodology.

events.title: Brisbane Sculpture Festival
events.description: An outdoor exhibition showcasing contemporary sculptural works within the natural setting of the Botanic Gardens. Ideal for those interested in design, materials, and art in public spaces.

events.title: Christmas in July ~ A Slow Stitch Workshop
events.description: A hands-on, community-focused workshop dedicated to the meditative craft of slow stitching. It encourages a relaxed social environment for creative makers.

events.title: Brisbane Makerspace Open Night
events.location: Brisbane Makerspace, 146 Wickham St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: A recurring community meetup at a local makerspace, where hackers, designers, and creatives meet to discuss ongoing projects and share technical knowledge. A highly social, inclusive environment.

events.title: The Art of Banksy “Without Limits” Exhibition
events.description: A touring exhibition featuring works by the street artist Banksy, focused on social commentary, irony, and modern political themes.
